name: Installed npm dependencies for inactive-project review
description: High-risk review example for node_modules whose parents contain both package.json and package-lock.json. Installed dependencies are not ordinary caches.

risk.rebuild_note: Reinstallation may be possible using the project's documented procedure only when manifests, lockfiles, the toolchain, and all dependencies remain available and no local changes need preservation. Shou does not run installation commands automatically.
limitations: Manifests and lockfiles establish project structure, not continued dependency availability.
Review private registries, offline dependencies, install scripts, manual edits, and local patches individually.

Not applicable to pnpm, Yarn zero-installs, shared stores, or local workspace dependencies with unverified reinstallation conditions. Treat recognized symbolic links as opaque entries and never follow them.
Age conditions do not prove inactivity. Explicitly exclude active projects and projects needed for offline work.
